new_session.cli_help.en:
Usage:
  remote-agent session create [flags] [-- cli-args]

Start a managed session without attaching and print its session ID.
Run "remote-agent models AGENT" first to inspect available model IDs, display names, supported efforts and this computer's effective defaults.

Flags:
  --agent {agents}          CLI to start (default: {defaultAgent})
  --cwd DIR                 working directory (default: current directory)
  --model MODEL             model ID or unambiguous display name (e.g. gemini-pro-orchestrator or "Orchestrator (Carbon)"; omit to follow machine/CLI default)
  --effort EFFORT           reasoning effort (omit to use default, or when "remote-agent models" shows "-")
  --mode MODE               explicit approval-mode override: ask|auto|full|plan (omit to follow machine/CLI defaults, matching Web/App new sessions; codex and claude switch to plan after launch)
  --standard-context        hold to the 200k standard context window (Claude Code)
  --title TITLE             session title (up to 60 characters)
  --prompt TEXT             first message sent once ready ("-" reads stdin)
  --login-shell             start through the user's login shell, like a client session
new_session.cli_help.notes: remote-agent session create --help 的命令行用法说明；agents 为可选 CLI 竖线列表，defaultAgent 为默认 CLI 标识。
new_session.cli_help.zh-CN:
用法：
  remote-agent session create [选项] [-- 底层CLI参数]

在后台启动托管会话，不占用当前终端，并向标准输出打印会话 ID。
先运行 remote-agent models AGENT 可查看可选模型 ID、显示名、支持的推理强度及本机默认配置。

选项：
  --agent {agents}          要启动的 CLI（默认：{defaultAgent}）
  --cwd DIR                 会话工作目录（默认：当前目录）
  --model MODEL             模型 ID 或客户端显示名（如 gemini-pro-orchestrator 或 "Orchestrator (Carbon)"；省略则跟随本机/CLI 默认值）
  --effort EFFORT           推理强度（省略则使用模型默认档位；models 表中标为 - 的模型无此项，请勿传入）
  --mode MODE               显式覆盖审批模式：ask|auto|full|plan（省略则跟随本机/CLI 默认配置，与网页/App 新建一致；codex 与 claude 需启动后再切 plan）
  --standard-context        固定为 200k 标准上下文窗口（仅 Claude Code）
  --title TITLE             会话标题（最多 60 个字）
  --prompt TEXT             CLI 就绪后自动发送的首条消息（"-" 从标准输入读取）
  --login-shell             经用户登录 shell 启动，与网页/App 客户端新建会话一致

new_session.cli_models_help.en:
Usage:
  remote-agent models [{agents}] [--json]

List available models, client display names, supported reasoning efforts, and effective new-session defaults on this computer.
Pass an agent ID (e.g. "remote-agent models agy") to inspect one CLI, or omit it to list all enabled installed CLIs.
new_session.cli_models_help.notes: remote-agent models --help 的命令行用法说明。
new_session.cli_models_help.zh-CN:
用法：
  remote-agent models [{agents}] [--json]

列出这台电脑上已启用 CLI 的可选模型、客户端显示名、支持的推理强度，以及不传参数新建会话时的生效默认配置。
指定单个 CLI（如 remote-agent models agy）时仅查询该 CLI；省略时依次列出所有可用的已启用 CLI。

new_session.cli_session_help.en:
Usage:
  remote-agent session create [flags] [-- args]         start a session without attaching (session create help)
  remote-agent session list [-a] [--json]               list sessions (-a includes exited sessions)
  remote-agent session get ID [--json]                  inspect one session
  remote-agent session attach ID                        attach to a running session
  remote-agent session send [--queue] ID TEXT           send a message ("-" reads stdin; --queue waits for the turn to end)
  remote-agent session cancel-input ID REQUEST-ID       withdraw a message the model has not received
  remote-agent session resume-input ID REQUEST-ID       send a message paused by an interrupted turn
  remote-agent session events ID [-f] [--json]          show or follow (-f) session events (supports --after N)
  remote-agent session approve [--always] ID APPROVAL-ID
                                                        allow a permission request (--always: stop asking for similar ones)
  remote-agent session deny [-m REASON] ID APPROVAL-ID  deny a permission request
  remote-agent session answer ID QUESTION-ID OPT[,OPT...]
                                                        answer a model question
  remote-agent session plan ID implement|clear|keep     answer "Implement this plan?"
  remote-agent session interrupt ID                     interrupt the running turn
  remote-agent session model ID MODEL [EFFORT]          switch a session's model (for CLIs that support mid-session switching)
  remote-agent session mode ID ask|auto|full|plan       switch a session's approval mode
  remote-agent session rename ID [TITLE]                title the session (omit TITLE to restore automatic title)
  remote-agent session compact ID                       compact the session's context
  remote-agent session stop ID                          end the session
  remote-agent session resume ID                        restart an exited session on the same conversation
  remote-agent session fork ID                          fork a new session from an existing conversation

Session IDs may be abbreviated to any unique prefix. Run "remote-agent models [{agents}]" to inspect available models and defaults.
new_session.cli_session_help.notes: remote-agent session help 的完整子命令参考。
new_session.cli_session_help.zh-CN:
用法：
  remote-agent session create [flags] [-- args]         后台新建托管会话（见 session create help）
  remote-agent session list [-a] [--json]               列出会话（-a 含已退出会话）
  remote-agent session get ID [--json]                  查看单个会话详情
  remote-agent session attach ID                        进入正在运行的会话终端
  remote-agent session send [--queue] ID TEXT           向会话发消息（"-" 读标准输入；--queue 等当前轮结束）
  remote-agent session cancel-input ID REQUEST-ID       撤回模型尚未收到的消息
  remote-agent session resume-input ID REQUEST-ID       继续发送因中断而暂停的消息
  remote-agent session events ID [-f] [--json]          查看或持续跟随（-f）会话事件流（支持 --after N）
  remote-agent session approve [--always] ID APPROVAL-ID
                                                        批准权限请求（--always：同类不再重复询问）
  remote-agent session deny [-m REASON] ID APPROVAL-ID  拒绝权限请求
  remote-agent session answer ID QUESTION-ID OPT[,OPT...]
                                                        回答模型的选择题
  remote-agent session plan ID implement|clear|keep     回答“是否实施此计划？”
  remote-agent session interrupt ID                     中断当前运行轮次
  remote-agent session model ID MODEL [EFFORT]          切换会话模型（支持运行中切模型的 CLI）
  remote-agent session mode ID ask|auto|full|plan       切换会话审批模式
  remote-agent session rename ID [TITLE]                重命名会话（省略标题恢复自动标题）
  remote-agent session compact ID                       压缩会话上下文
  remote-agent session stop ID                          结束会话
  remote-agent session resume ID                        重新启动已退出的会话并继续原对话
  remote-agent session fork ID                          从已有对话分叉出新会话

会话 ID 均可简写为任意唯一前缀。查看可选模型与默认配置请运行 remote-agent models [{agents}]。

schedule.cli_mcp_help.en:
Usage:
  remote-agent mcp [--session ID]

Internal subcommand injected automatically into managed sessions (with RA_SESSION set) to serve session-bound MCP tools (remote_agent) over stdio:
  - send_file: offer a local file as a downloadable card in this conversation
  - notify_user: send an explicit notification during a scheduled turn
  - schedule_*: manage tasks delegated by this session within its project/mode scope

For machine-wide session, model or schedule control, use "remote-agent session", "remote-agent models" and "remote-agent schedule".
schedule.cli_mcp_help.notes: remote-agent mcp --help 的命令行说明，阐述内置会话级 MCP 与机器级 CLI 子命令的职责边界。
schedule.cli_mcp_help.zh-CN:
用法：
  remote-agent mcp [--session ID]

内部子命令：由 daemon 为每个托管会话自动注入并设置 RA_SESSION，在 stdio 上提供单会话绑定的 MCP 工具（remote_agent）：
  - send_file：在当前对话气泡中向客户端交付本机文件以供下载
  - notify_user：在定时执行轮次内主动向客户端发送通知
  - schedule_*：受限于本会话项目与权限范围的定时任务委托

跨会话或整机控制请使用 remote-agent session、remote-agent models 与 remote-agent schedule 子命令。

security.migration_acceptance_corrupt.en: Generation-3 request records failed validation; their original deadlines cannot be trusted. Upgrade was refused. The source, backup and generation marker were not changed. Keep the daemon stopped and verify the source or a valid backup; do not alter deadlines or skip damaged records.
security.migration_acceptance_corrupt.notes: 手动 v3→v4 升级及 dry-run 在任何接受记录形状或原 checksum 不符时显示。不得包含请求 ID、内容、路径或密钥；不要暗示可通过删坏记录继续迁移。
security.migration_acceptance_corrupt.zh-CN: 第 3 代请求记录校验失败，无法信任原请求期限。升级已拒绝，原库、备份和代数标记未改动；请保持 daemon 停止，核对原库或有效备份，不要修改期限或跳过损坏记录。

security.migration_complete.en: Upgrade validated; no pairing is needed. The source backup is security-v3.db.backup. Direct rollback is safe only before v4 accepts new operations: stop the daemon, move security-v4.db and its -wal/-shm files aside, then run the old version. Otherwise follow the development guide to check operations and let their authorizations expire first.
security.migration_complete.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_complete.zh-CN: 升级完成并校验通过，无需重新配对。原库备份为 security-v3.db.backup。仅在 v4 尚未接受新操作时可直接回退：先停止 daemon，移走 security-v4.db 及其 -wal/-shm 文件，再运行旧版。已有 v4 操作时请先按开发说明核对并等待授权期限结束。

security.migration_dry_run.en: Dry run validated; the source is unchanged. Pairing identity, security chain, keys and lease will be preserved; session and account files stay unchanged.
security.migration_dry_run.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_dry_run.zh-CN: 演练验证通过，原库未修改。配对身份、安全链、密钥和租约将原样保留，会话与账户文件不变。

security.migration_failed.en: Upgrade did not complete; the source was not replaced. Check that --home is an existing state directory with daemon.lock, the daemon is stopped, target and backup are absent, disk is writable, the source is valid generation 3, the clock is correct, old deadlines have passed and existing time floors are not far ahead. Publication failure removes files created by this attempt where possible; if cleanup also fails, keep the daemon stopped and resolve leftover files before retrying.
security.migration_failed.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_failed.zh-CN: 升级未完成，原库未替换。请确认 --home 是已有状态目录且有 daemon.lock、daemon 已停止、目标和备份尚不存在、磁盘可写、原库为第 3 代且完整、电脑时间正确、旧请求期限已过且旧水位没有明显领先当前时钟。发布失败会尝试清理本次创建的文件；清理也失败时需停机处理残留文件后重试。

security.migration_old_results.en: Generation 3 acceptance records are not migrated. Old ID queries return unknown and are never reexecuted; check the session before deciding on a new operation. Check the computer clock first; migration preserves old request deadlines and existing time floors without adding the migration time as a new floor.
security.migration_old_results.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_old_results.zh-CN: 第 3 代接受记录不会迁移。旧 ID 的结果查询将返回未知，绝不重新执行；请核对会话后再决定新操作。请先校准电脑时间；迁移保留旧请求期限和已有时间水位，不把迁移时刻写成新水位。

security.migration_usage.en: Usage: go run ./scripts/migrate-security-v4 --home DIR [--dry-run] [--locale zh-CN|en]. DIR must be an existing state directory with security-v3.db and daemon.lock. Check the computer clock, stop the daemon and check old operations first.
security.migration_usage.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.migration_usage.zh-CN: 用法：go run ./scripts/migrate-security-v4 --home DIR [--dry-run] [--locale zh-CN|en]。DIR 必须是已有状态目录（含 security-v3.db 和 daemon.lock）；先校准电脑时间、停止 daemon 并核对旧操作。

security.request_identity_conflict.en: The request ID was reused with a different payload; the original result is unchanged.
security.request_identity_conflict.notes: 电脑端已认证的请求身份冲突；不泄露原载荷或结果。
security.request_identity_conflict.zh-CN: 同一请求 ID 对应不同载荷；原操作结果未改变。

security.result_body_unavailable.en: The operation is settled, but its result body is unavailable.
security.result_body_unavailable.notes: 电脑端精简终局存在但未能保留正文；第 6 步 wire 接入前不作为客户端业务正文。
security.result_body_unavailable.zh-CN: 操作已定案，但结果正文无法恢复。

security.storage_v4_required.en: Local security storage needs generation 4. Stop the daemon and run scripts/migrate-security-v4; pairing is preserved. Old request results cannot be recovered; check pending operations first.
security.storage_v4_required.notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。
security.storage_v4_required.zh-CN: 本机安全库需要升级到第 4 代。请先停止 daemon，运行 scripts/migrate-security-v4；无需重新配对。旧请求结果无法恢复，请先核对在途操作。

startup.cli_removed_session_cmd.notes: 用户或旧脚本调用已移除的顶层平铺会话命令时的迁移错误提示。
startup.cli_removed_session_cmd.zh-CN: remote-agent：子命令「{cmd}」已移至「remote-agent {replacement}」（详见 remote-agent session help）

startup.cli_usage.en:
remote-agent: operate native AI coding CLIs running in tmux

Usage:
{agentLines}
  remote-agent session OPERATION           create, inspect and control sessions (session help)
  remote-agent models [{agents}]       list models, efforts and defaults on this computer
  remote-agent schedule OPERATION          manage persistent timed Agent messages (schedule help)
  remote-agent account join|secret|status  connect this machine to a server
  remote-agent update [check|status|auto]  update the daemon (update help)
  remote-agent doctor [{agents}]       check that installed CLIs work with remote-agent
  remote-agent daemon [flags]              run the daemon in the foreground
  remote-agent --version                   show product version and source revision
startup.cli_usage.notes: remote-agent --help 顶层命令行用法说明；agentLines 为已注册 CLI 直启命令行，agents 为竖线分隔的 CLI 列表。

agentLines.example: remote-agent codex [codex args]          start a Codex session here and attach to it

startup.cli_usage.zh-CN:
remote-agent：在 tmux 中托管与操控本机 AI 编程 CLI

用法：
{agentLines}
  remote-agent session OPERATION           创建、查看与操控托管会话（见 session help）
  remote-agent models [{agents}]           查看这台电脑可用的模型、推理强度与默认配置
  remote-agent schedule OPERATION          管理持久定时任务（见 schedule help）
  remote-agent account join|secret|status  将本机连接到账户服务器
  remote-agent update [check|status|auto]  更新 daemon（见 update help）
  remote-agent doctor [{agents}]           检查已安装的 CLI 是否与 remote-agent 兼容
  remote-agent daemon [flags]              在前台运行 daemon
  remote-agent --version                   查看产品版本与源码修订
